mapper.select: select id, task_id, calibration_formula, channel_name, normal_range, detect_method, sigma_value, fluctuation_rate, chauvenet_coef, min_sample_count, iterate_count, sample_window, dynamic_update, auto_clean from calib_channel_config where task_id = #{taskId} and enabled = 1 and is_deleted = 0 order by id
mapper.insert:
insert into calib_record_detail (task_id, channel_id, interface_id, channel_name, parameter_name, tm_symbol, telemetry_value, detail, is_deleted, create_time) values
(#{detail.taskId}, #{detail.channelId}, #{detail.interfaceId}, #{detail.channelName}, #{detail.parameterName}, #{detail.tmSymbol}, #{detail.telemetryValue}, #{detail.detail}, 0, #{detail.createTime})
mapper.update: update calib_record set outlier_count = outlier_count + #{outlierCount}, update_time = current_timestamp where channel_id = #{channelId} and is_deleted = 0
